# Configuration

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_config_docs.py from src/nexus_mcp/config.py. Do not edit. -->

Set these as environment variables of the server, for example `claude mcp add nexus-mcp -e NEXUS_SEARCH_MODE=bm25 -- nexus-mcp-ci`. An invalid value logs a warning and keeps the default.

## Server

| Variable | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `NEXUS_STORAGE_DIR` | `.nexus` | Folder for the index, memories and graph. Relative to the folder the server starts in. |
| `NEXUS_EMBEDDING_MODEL` | `bge-small-en` | Embedding model key. Only registered models load. Re-index after a change. |
| `NEXUS_EMBEDDING_DEVICE` | `auto` | `auto`, `cpu`, `cuda` or `mps`. |
| `NEXUS_EMBEDDING_BATCH_SIZE` | `32` | Chunks embedded in one batch. |
| `NEXUS_MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB` | `10` | Skip files larger than this. |
| `NEXUS_MAX_WORKERS` | unset | Parser threads. Empty means the default of the thread pool. |
| `NEXUS_CHUNK_MAX_CHARS` | `4000` | Largest code snippet stored for one chunk. |
| `NEXUS_INDEX_FILE_BATCH_SIZE` | `50` | Files parsed and stored in one streaming batch. |
| `NEXUS_GRAPH_MAX_DEPTH` | `10` | Deepest traversal of `graph` with `transitive=true`. |
| `NEXUS_SEARCH_MODE` | `hybrid` | `hybrid`, `vector` or `bm25`. |
| `NEXUS_FUSION_WEIGHT_VECTOR` | `0.5` | Weight of vector results in Reciprocal Rank Fusion. |
| `NEXUS_FUSION_WEIGHT_BM25` | `0.3` | Weight of BM25 results in Reciprocal Rank Fusion. |
| `NEXUS_MAX_MEMORY_MB` | `350` | Memory budget in MB (about 90 MB idle, 460 MB with the model loaded). |
| `NEXUS_AUTO_RESTORE` | `true` | Attach the stored index when a new server process starts. |
| `NEXUS_WARM_START` | `true` | Load the index and the model in the background while the server starts. |
| `NEXUS_AUTO_WATCH` | `true` | Watch indexed folders and reindex changed files in the background. |
| `NEXUS_STALENESS_CHECK_INTERVAL` | `15.0` | Seconds between stale-file checks in `status` and `search`. |
| `NEXUS_LOG_LEVEL` | `INFO` | `DEBUG`, `INFO`, `WARNING` or `ERROR`. |
| `NEXUS_LOG_FORMAT` | `text` | `text` or `json`. |
| `NEXUS_TRUST_REMOTE_CODE` | `true` | Needed only by the deprecated `jina-code` model. |
| `NEXUS_AUTH_MODE` | `none` | `none` or `local`. |
| `NEXUS_PERMISSION_LEVEL` | `full` | `full`, or `read` to block tools that change the index or memory. |
| `NEXUS_AUDIT_ENABLED` | `true` | Log each tool call with a correlation id. Secret fields are redacted. |
| `NEXUS_AUDIT_LOG_FILE` | unset | Write the audit log to this file. Empty means stderr. |
| `NEXUS_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED` | `false` | Turn on per-tool token-bucket rate limits. |
| `NEXUS_RATE_LIMIT_DEFAULT_RATE` | `10.0` | Requests per second for each tool. |
| `NEXUS_RATE_LIMIT_DEFAULT_BURST` | `20` | Burst size for each tool. |

## Privacy and the eval CLI

| Variable | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `NEXUS_OFFLINE` | unset | Set to `1` to block the model download (sets `HF_HUB_OFFLINE` and `TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE`). |
| `NEXUS_EVAL_HOME` | `~/.nexus-mcp/evals` | Where `nexus-mcp-ci eval` saves its reports. |
| `NEXUS_EVAL_CACHE` | `~/.cache/nexus-mcp/eval` | Where `eval <url>` keeps its clones. |
| `NEXUS_EVAL_PRICING` | unset | A JSON file of Codex prices (USD per million tokens) for `eval --agent codex`. |

`HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY` is set to `1` unless you set it yourself. See [PRIVACY.md](PRIVACY.md).
